resources.string: Configure the default interpreter, working directory, direct execution and permission. This screen does not run commands.
Review the exact selected code. Choose its interpreter deliberately. Commands can alter your files or system. Nothing runs until you confirm execution.
Termux must be installed with Zsh and the selected interpreter. Enable allow-external-apps in Termux yourself if you wish to use its external command API. HookLab never changes this setting.

Configure interpreter, directory and command permission.

Opt in only if you trust the entire installed ChatGPT process, including its hooks. A terminal tap runs code without another review. HookLab cannot distinguish a tap from other code inside that trusted process. Save defaults to authorize or revoke.
